verdict.rationale: Mercury shows some embedded AI automation (AI-populated bill details, AI-powered bookkeeping automations, auto-attached receipts) and an MCP interface that lets an agent query balances/transactions, but there's no evidence of proactive AI-generated insights, spend analysis, forecasting, or suggestions surfaced inside the product itself. missing for 10: dedicated insights/analytics dashboard, proactive spend/cashflow suggestions, forecasting or anomaly detection, independent confirmation of AI-generated recommendations.
